_comment: Activates brand-lint from the miragon-brand plugin (Claude Code hook and CI). The repo is English, so the German-only copy rules are off: du (A1), umlauts (A3), German passive (A4), German claim (A7), gender forms (A11). C5 stays on: in a modeler repo it checks that the whole tool speaks one language. The docs kit in docs/.vitepress/miragon/ is linted at its source in Miragon/corporate-identity. Only the published docs are linted: code, maintainer docs (ADRs, contributing) and GitHub templates are ignored.
